value_updates.referral_operation: Each NFT minted by the new active contract uses its mint number as its permanent referral code; old-contract NFT mint numbers are excluded from the referral system. Successful coded referrals earn $5 and a current Small Block prize ticket, while a mint without a valid referral code sends the commission and ticket to a random eligible holder in the new active contract.
